title: Inbound MX receive and shared durable mailbox store
summary: The dev7.4 Git line composes the owned inbound SMTP service over the restart-safe Storage Fabric store and exposes the same mailbox/object authority to IMAP as a read-side projection. One RFC822 body is stored; mailbox membership is projection state.
invariants: Internet-origin MX SMTP may be unauthenticated, but this inbound service profile delivers only configured local domains and does not provide authenticated relay.
Verified signed inbound mail projects to INBOX; unsigned or invalid-signature inbound mail projects to INBOX-UNSIGNED unless ingress policy rejects or quarantines it.
A mixed local+relay SMTP transaction is rejected before any local storage side effect, preventing duplicate-delivery ambiguity.
The restart-safe dev7.3 Storage Fabric object and mailbox membership remain the authoritative mail state; the IMAP adapter creates no second message body.
The initial IMAP projection is read-only. FETCH/STORE/EXPUNGE server semantics must preserve the same object/membership authority when implemented.

LDAP Bind and message signing do not confer MAIL_READ or EMAIL_SEND. Authenticated mailbox/submission services require active attributed IdentityDirectory principals and explicit Access Permissions authority.
Autobuilder is not running; production host installation, firewall and DNS/MX activation are separate operator-gated actions.
